text: Cheat sheet: front of the ankle, medial → lateral (Tom Has Very Nice Dancing Pigs): tibialis anterior, extensor hallucis longus, anterior tibial vessels, deep fibular nerve, extensor digitorum longus, peroneus tertius. Anterior tibial artery → dorsalis pedis. Save for your next anatomy exam. #anatomy #medstudent
